items.title: Live: Israel announces 'limited' ground operation in southern Lebanon against Hezbollah
items.description: The ​Israeli ‌military has ​begun ‌"limited" ground operations against ​Hezbollah ‌positions ⁠in ‌southern ‌Lebanon. Follow live.

items.title: What analysing Trump's statements on the war tell us about his plans
items.description: Two weeks after the US and Israel first struck Iran, Donald Trump's timeline and end goal for the war remain uncertain.

items.title: David Speirs says he is 'owning' his drug conviction as he chases a return to office
items.description: One-time Liberal opposition leader David Speirs is attempting a political comeback, but even he concedes it's a long shot after a very public downfall where he was convicted of supplying cocaine just over 10 months ago.

items.title: Paul Keating throws weight behind fight to save historic assets from sale
items.description: Opposition is growing to the federal government's plan to sell scores of defence properties to reduce maintenance and repair costs, as locals fight back.

items.title: Network hit with licence conditions after Kyle and Jackie O breaches
items.description: The media watchdog imposes fresh conditions on KIIS FM owner ARN Media, in response to repeated breaches by controversial radio show The Kyle & Jackie O Show.

items.title: Sydney Swans take responsibility for Bondi tribute script change
items.description: The club says it takes full responsibility for a script change that removed references to the Jewish community during an opening round tribute to Bondi victims.

items.title: Conan O'Brien's zinger for Rose Byrne and a standing ovation: Your key Oscars moments
items.description: Australians have missed out in every key category at the 98th Academy Awards. Michael B Jordan gets a standing ovation when winning Best Actor for Sinners. And Conan O'Brien also "wins". Here are your Oscars key moments.

items.title: A third of all Victorian car thefts now involve key cloning devices
items.description: Police say criminals are able to steal certain push-button start models within 15 seconds, using key reprogramming devices bought online.

items.title: Matildas coy about star duo's chances of facing China in Asian Cup semi
items.description: Hayley Raso and Steph Catley are available for selection, but it remains to be seen what role they will have against China in Perth.

items.title: A dead shark, sick surfers and the four-month wait to warn the public
items.description: The government knew a harmful toxin had been found in its algal bloom, but took months to update its health advice.

items.title: Mother was 'living beyond her means' during fake cancer scam, court hears
items.description: An Adelaide mother who faked her six-year-old son's cancer diagnosis to deceitfully raise money was "living the life of the rich and famous" despite serious financial struggles, a court has heard.

items.title: Family of 6yo who fell from lookout on a mission to establish sensory-safe parks
items.description: The family of a six-year-old girl with autism who fell from the cliffs at a popular NSW South Coast lookout a year ago want to see more inclusive public spaces.

items.title: Danish royals honour fallen, meet the public at Australian War Memorial
items.description: A crowd of people waving Danish flags waited outside the Australian War Memorial for a chance to meet King Frederick and Queen Mary on day three of their royal tour.

items.title: Judge rejects bid to stay charges over 'seizure' crash that killed four
items.description: A judge refuses a request from defence lawyers to throw out charges regarding a fatal crash near Shepparton.

items.title: Let your slow cooker do the work with these set-and-forget comfort meals
items.description: We've pulled together four lovely recipes that make weeknight meals a little easier (and quite budget friendly, too).

items.title: These musicians stole our hearts on The Piano. Where are they now?
items.description: In the first season of The Piano, nobody quite knew what to expect. But what happens after you get the chance to play for a national audience? We catch up with some of the pianists to find out how music continues to shape their lives.

items.title: What is 'lifestyle creep' — and how can you avoid it?
items.description: If you tend to splurge on more indulgences any time you receive a pay rise, you may be suffering from lifestyle creep — and it could have a longstanding effect on your finances.

items.title: 'High chance' of Qld cyclone forming this week after more rain
items.description: A tropical low sitting south of the Solomon Islands now has a "high chance" of becoming a cyclone as it heads towards the Queensland coast.

items.title: Former Origin player Chris Walker bailed after appearing in court on DV charges
items.description: Christopher Walker was arrested after he was allegedly found hiding in the backyard of a Gold Coast home.

items.title: Police charge author Craig Silvey with more child exploitation offences
items.description: Popular Australian author Craig Silvey is charged with two more child exploitation offences, including allegedly producing child exploitation material.

items.title: 'I have no words': The Iran war death toll reaches the Himalayan foothills
items.description: The killing of a Nepali security guard in Abu Dhabi highlights the growing risks faced by millions of migrant workers across the Gulf as the conflict between Iran, Israel and the United States escalates.

items.title: Rising oil price and inflation fears make rate hike likely
items.description: A war in Iran has led to a cost-of-living spike in Australia and as petrol prices rise, interest rates are likely to be next.

items.title: Aged care minister pursues claims homes charging premium for basic services
items.description: Aged care providers have been able to charge a higher everyday living fee since November, but some residents say it is being applied for services they are unable to use.

items.title: Homicide squad called in over grim highway find in Victoria's west
items.description: Homicide squad detectives are investigating the death of a man whose body was found in the western Victorian town of Jung.

items.title: 'A confronting case': Woman pleads guilty to 21 animal cruelty charges
items.description: A Tasmanian woman has pleaded guilty to 21 animal cruelty charges. More than 70 animals were found living in "squalid" conditions, with some requiring euthanasing.
